NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To suggest your latest video in Spotter, as you asked. Spotto only reads the most recent one and never changes your gallery; only a few frames leave your iPhone, when you tap “Search”.
NSCameraUsageDescription: To take a photo, from Spotter, of a piece you want to find. The photo isn't saved to your gallery; it only leaves your iPhone when you tap “Search”.
